tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: chos bdag bar chad sel ba'i chos bka' las: 'jam dpal nag po'i yang zlog bsam gtan nyal chog bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra mthu chen padma 'byung gnas kyis: rno myur thog 'dra'i lha mchog gshin rje gshed: 'jam dpal nag po gza' gdon dmar nag gi: thub pa bsam gtan nyal chog man ngag bshad: 'di nyid nyams su lon pa'i gang zag rnams: gnam lcags pha lam mi shigs gur dang mtshungs: skal ldan gsung gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: ྈྈྈ yang zlog nang nas nying zlog srung ba'i mchog: sngags pa stong sde byad mkhan 'bum phrag gis: sbyor ngan gshed 'bebs slar bzlogs mi 'byung ba: yang gsang thub chod ral gri phyung rdeg go: dang po dben par bde ba'i stan la 'dug: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa bya: de yi ngang la chos kun stong par bsgom: bhrūm̐ las rang nyid gnas pa'i khang pa 'di: gnam lcags pha lam las grub sku gdung dbus: paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng: dhīḥyig nag po 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: de nyid yongs gyur 'jam dpal ha la'i mdog: phyag g.yas gnam lcags ral gri klad la bskor: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub reg gcod 'khor lo bskor: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung drang por bzhugs: ral pa'i thor cog sher phyin glegs bam 'dzin: rin chen dar zab longs spyod rdzogs pa'i tshul: gnas gsum 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' bstim: rang gi snying nang padma 'dab bzhi'i steng: nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su sa bon dhī: mtha' skor gzungs sngags snying pos bskor ba las: ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer ni: lcags kyu ral gri'i gzugs spros stong khams gang: srid gsum gnas pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma bkug: rang nyid 'jam dpal nag po'i mdun ngos su: gza' gdon dmar nag sde brgyad kun 'dus sku: rtsa zhal srin po khros pa'i rnam pa can: lto ba srid pa gsum po brub pa'i zhal: sku stod khro bo sku rked sdig pa ste: sku smad sbrul mjug sku la gza' mig spras: dpral ba phyag gnyis lcags khro zangs gsum las:

grub pa'i bde gshegs sku gdung re re bsnams: khrag mtsho me rlung du 'tshubs klong du bsgom: mdzub mo lcags gtan mthe bong st+wa gri dang: phreng rdog byad ma'i mgo bor dngos su bsgom: nyi zla'i mthil du: drag sngags re bzlas phreng rdog re bzhin bskyur: byad ma'i mgo bo mgrin pa nas bcad pa: khrag 'dzag bzhin pa phrul phrul mdun bskyed kyi: lto ba'i zhal du sib sib bstab par sgoms: dmigs pa'i 'phrul 'khor skad cig mi g.yel bar: gnam lcags lhung ba bzhin du drag sngags bzla: oṃ mañdzu shrī kā la tsitta hūm̐: rn+riḥtri dgra bgegs byad ma sha trūṃ mā ra ya hur thums rbad zlog: gnod byed tsitta rū pa dha: ha pa tsa tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa: de ltar bzlas pas nyams dang rmi lam du: lus las me 'bar dgra las rgyal ba dang: mtshon cha thogs nas sems can srog chags bsad: snying dang rgyu ma sha khrag za ba sogs: de rnams byung na 'grub pa'i mtshan ma yin: thun mtshams gnas lugs ngang la mnyam par bzhag: 'di ni bsam gtan nyal chog man ngag ste: kun la ma bstan dam tshig sa ma ya: ma 'ongs o rgyan gsung sras snying gi bur: sngags pa rdo rje nang dme byed pa dang: pha rol byad ma mkhan gyis 'tshe ba'i dus: phas rgol gshed 'beb rang nyid srung ba'i mchog: bya sla tshegs chung don ldan snying nor 'di: bstan srung bar chad sel ba'i btsas su bzhag: gān7thā: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: goha rgya rgya: n+ya n+ya n+yā: chos bdag bar chad sel ba'i chos ka rlung gi 'khor lo byams pa'i snying mdzod nas chos rje gling pas gdan drangs pa'o/// /
